# CRECO — Commercial Real Estate Company

> CRECO is a full-service Texas commercial real estate brokerage headquartered in Fair Oaks Ranch (San Antonio metro), TREC #9014367-BB. We represent tenants, owners, and investors across retail, industrial, office, flex, and land — for lease and for sale — statewide, with deep coverage of San Antonio, Austin, Houston, and Dallas–Fort Worth. Phone: (210) 817-3443. Email: info@crecotx.com.

## Services
- [Commercial real estate services](https://www.crecotx.com/services): Tenant representation, owner-side leasing and sales, investment advisory, property management, and development.
- [Owner services](https://www.crecotx.com/owner-services): Hold/sell analysis, repositioning, 1031 exchange identification, and portfolio strategy for multi-property owners.
- [Free property valuation](https://www.crecotx.com/property-valuation): Instant cap-rate-based preliminary value range — no contact info required to see the number.
